part.text:
Fixed. The root cause: each `render()` call creates a new root vnode (`parentDom._children`), discarding the `_mask` counter that `useId` relies on to generate unique ids, so the counter reset to `[0, 0]` on every render.

The fix in `hooks/src/index.js`:
1. Added an `options._root` hook (hooks/src/index.js:39-50) that copies `_mask` from the previous tree root (`parentDom._children._mask`) onto the new root vnode, chaining any pre-existing `options._root` hook.
2. Simplified the `useId` root-walk condition (hooks/src/index.js:442) to match.

Verification: `npm run tsc` (checkJs) and eslint/prettier pass, and the full karma suite runs green — 1126 tests pass, including the previously failing `should return a unique id across invocations of render` in `hooks/test/browser/useId.test.js:437` (ids now stay unique across multiple `render()` calls, e.g. `P0-0`, `P0-1`).
